name: spatial-ui
description: Depth-first restyling in both dialects, native XR and the flat-screen depth idiom most teams actually ship — the translucent-depth language in which depth is GEOMETRY, not material. Emits a six-step translateZ ladder with the counter-scale that holds apparent size constant, puts the camera on exactly one stage element, converts toolbars to orbiters, adds reduced-motion-guarded pointer parallax, gives every movable or resizable panel a non-drag alternative, and self-audits every emitted surface against WCAG 2.2. Translucent panels with no camera are glassmorphism-ui (blurred) or liquid-glass-ui (refracting).
